source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_contract
source_only_request_ladder.question: What exact paper-level source-only promise does the public sentence make?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the exact paper-level source-only promise and its maintained packet/menu/validator cut.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The public request contract is the first sufficient owner for what the paper promised and which maintained cut stands behind that promise.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes omitted-support family naming, fulfillment/completion, or visible notice realization.

source_only_request_ladder.label: requestable_evidence_classes
source_only_request_ladder.question: Which omitted-support family names does that promise actually cover?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is naming or typing the omitted-support families behind the paper-level promise.
source_only_request_ladder.why: Evidence classes stabilize the support-family names without re-owning packet cuts or status compression.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes whether one such family has been fully supplied or how it is compressed publicly.

source_only_request_ladder.label: request_fulfillment_certificates
source_only_request_ladder.question: Has one promised omitted-support family actually been fully supplied?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is whether a promised omitted-support family has been fully satisfied.
source_only_request_ladder.why: Fulfillment certificates are the first sufficient owner for family-scoped completion rather than mere family naming.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes paper-level status compression or cross-release carryforward.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_status_envelope
source_only_request_ladder.question: What is the within-release paper-level public status of the overall source-only promise?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the within-release paper-level status token for the overall source-only promise.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The status envelope compresses fulfilled families to one paper-level public token without re-owning the certificates beneath it.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes successor carryforward or visible notice wording.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_carryforward_envelope
source_only_request_ladder.question: Does that paper-level source-only request status persist, advance, or reopen across the successor release?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is cross-release carryforward of the paper-level source-only request status token.
source_only_request_ladder.why: Carryforward is the first sufficient owner for successor persistence or reopening of the paper-level request promise.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes the exact outward-facing notice sentence or canonical family choice.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_notice
source_only_request_ladder.question: What exact outward-facing source-only notice sentence and pointer order were emitted?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the exact outward-facing source-only notice sentence and its reader-pointer order.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The notice is the first sufficient owner for what readers actually saw at paper level.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes the canonical notice family or slot structure behind that sentence.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_notice_normal_form
source_only_request_ladder.question: Which canonical notice family and slot structure sits behind that emitted source-only notice?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the canonical notice family and slot structure behind the emitted source-only notice.
source_only_request_ladder.why: Normal forms own the reusable notice family rather than the emitted sentence instance.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes which canonical family was selected for this release.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_notice_selection
source_only_request_ladder.question: Which canonical source-only notice family was actually selected for the current release?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is which canonical source-only notice family was actually selected for this release.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The selection ledger is the last paper-level source-only owner before one concrete follow-up class is fixed.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if one follow-up class is fixed and the question becomes the exact response-menu / request-class-owner / response-packet / packet-scope / packet-family-basis / packet-support-surface / packet-manifest-cut / packet-inventory-cut / packet-carryforward-profile / packet-delta-ledger chain.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_response_menu
source_only_request_ladder.question: Once one follow-up class is fixed, which maintained owner is the smallest sufficient handoff?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the notice-keyed follow-up owner choice after one concrete follow-up class is fixed.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The response menu is the first sufficient owner once the question leaves paper-level notice choice and fixes a follow-up class.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes the exact bounded packet slice that should travel or the packet-carryforward-profile / packet-delta-ledger chain beneath it.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_response_packet
source_only_request_ladder.question: What exact bounded source-only handoff slice should travel for that follow-up class?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the exact bounded response packet that should travel for the selected follow-up class.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The response packet is the first sufficient owner for the concrete bounded handoff slice itself.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes whether that exact packet may be reused or which fields refresh.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_response_packet_carryforward
source_only_request_ladder.question: May that exact bounded response packet be reused unchanged, refreshed, or must it reopen in the successor release?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is whether an already-cut bounded response packet survives, refreshes, or reopens across the successor release.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The carryforward profile is the first sufficient owner for packet reuse posture across releases.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes which packet-local field families refresh inside a reusable packet.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_response_packet_delta
source_only_request_ladder.question: If a response packet is reused, what exact packet-local field families refresh?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the exact packet-local refresh delta for a reusable bounded response packet.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The delta ledger is the last notice-keyed packet owner before visible refresh wording begins.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes the visible successor-facing refresh sentence or family built on that delta.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_response_packet_refresh_notice
source_only_request_ladder.question: What exact visible reissue sentence may be surfaced for a reusable response packet?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the exact visible refresh sentence for a reusable bounded response packet.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The refresh notice is the first sufficient owner for what readers may visibly see when a packet is reissued.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes the canonical visible refresh family or the selection among such families.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_response_packet_refresh_notice_normal_form
source_only_request_ladder.question: Which canonical visible reissue wrapper family sits behind that emitted refresh sentence?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the canonical visible refresh wrapper family and slot structure.
source_only_request_ladder.why: Normal forms own the reusable visible reissue family rather than the emitted sentence instance.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes which visible refresh family was selected for this packet.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_response_packet_refresh_notice_selection
source_only_request_ladder.question: Which canonical visible refresh family was selected for the current reusable packet?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is which canonical visible refresh family was selected for the current reusable packet.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The selection ledger is the last visible-refresh owner before a successor-facing follow-up is fixed.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes a successor-facing follow-up choice or closure question about that visible sentence.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_response_packet_refresh_response_menu
source_only_request_ladder.question: After one concrete follow-up about the visible refresh sentence, which successor-facing owner is first sufficient?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the successor-facing follow-up owner choice after one concrete question about a visible refresh sentence.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The successor-facing response menu is the first sufficient owner once one visible-refresh follow-up class is fixed.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes the exact successor-facing packet cut or whether that branch is already closed.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_response_packet_refresh_response_packet
source_only_request_ladder.question: What exact successor-facing bounded packet should travel for that visible-refresh follow-up?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the exact successor-facing bounded packet cut for the selected visible-refresh follow-up.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The successor-facing response packet is the first sufficient owner for the concrete refreshed handoff slice itself.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes whether that refreshed visible branch is already closed under the shipped taxonomy.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_response_packet_refresh_response_packet_closure
source_only_request_ladder.question: Does that successor-facing refresh-response packet already close the branch, and what would reopen it?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is whether the successor-facing refresh-response packet already closes the branch and which local triggers would reopen it.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The closure verdict is the capstone owner for terminal-stop posture, reopen triggers, and reopen-owner recovery on the visible refresh branch.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Do not widen unless the shipped follow-up taxonomy itself changes or a listed reopen trigger fires.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_contract
source_only_request_ladder.question: What exact paper-level source-only promise does the public sentence make?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the exact paper-level source-only promise and its maintained packet/menu/validator cut.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The public request contract is the first sufficient owner for what the paper promised and which maintained cut stands behind that promise.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes omitted-support family naming, fulfillment/completion, or visible notice realization.

source_only_request_ladder.label: requestable_evidence_classes
source_only_request_ladder.question: Which omitted-support family names does that promise actually cover?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is naming or typing the omitted-support families behind the paper-level promise.
source_only_request_ladder.why: Evidence classes stabilize the support-family names without re-owning packet cuts or status compression.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes whether one such family has been fully supplied or how it is compressed publicly.

source_only_request_ladder.label: request_fulfillment_certificates
source_only_request_ladder.question: Has one promised omitted-support family actually been fully supplied?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is whether a promised omitted-support family has been fully satisfied.
source_only_request_ladder.why: Fulfillment certificates are the first sufficient owner for family-scoped completion rather than mere family naming.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes paper-level status compression or cross-release carryforward.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_status_envelope
source_only_request_ladder.question: What is the within-release paper-level public status of the overall source-only promise?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the within-release paper-level status token for the overall source-only promise.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The status envelope compresses fulfilled families to one paper-level public token without re-owning the certificates beneath it.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes successor carryforward or visible notice wording.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_carryforward_envelope
source_only_request_ladder.question: Does that paper-level source-only request status persist, advance, or reopen across the successor release?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is cross-release carryforward of the paper-level source-only request status token.
source_only_request_ladder.why: Carryforward is the first sufficient owner for successor persistence or reopening of the paper-level request promise.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes the exact outward-facing notice sentence or canonical family choice.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_notice
source_only_request_ladder.question: What exact outward-facing source-only notice sentence and pointer order were emitted?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the exact outward-facing source-only notice sentence and its reader-pointer order.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The notice is the first sufficient owner for what readers actually saw at paper level.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes the canonical notice family or slot structure behind that sentence.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_notice_normal_form
source_only_request_ladder.question: Which canonical notice family and slot structure sits behind that emitted source-only notice?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the canonical notice family and slot structure behind the emitted source-only notice.
source_only_request_ladder.why: Normal forms own the reusable notice family rather than the emitted sentence instance.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes which canonical family was selected for this release.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_notice_selection
source_only_request_ladder.question: Which canonical source-only notice family was actually selected for the current release?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is which canonical source-only notice family was actually selected for this release.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The selection ledger is the last paper-level source-only owner before one concrete follow-up class is fixed.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if one follow-up class is fixed and the question becomes the exact response-menu / request-class-owner / response-packet / packet-scope / packet-family-basis / packet-support-surface / packet-manifest-cut / packet-inventory-cut / packet-carryforward-profile / packet-delta-ledger chain.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_response_menu
source_only_request_ladder.question: Once one follow-up class is fixed, which maintained owner is the smallest sufficient handoff?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the notice-keyed follow-up owner choice after one concrete follow-up class is fixed.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The response menu is the first sufficient owner once the question leaves paper-level notice choice and fixes a follow-up class.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes the exact bounded packet slice that should travel or the packet-carryforward-profile / packet-delta-ledger chain beneath it.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_response_packet
source_only_request_ladder.question: What exact bounded source-only handoff slice should travel for that follow-up class?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the exact bounded response packet that should travel for the selected follow-up class.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The response packet is the first sufficient owner for the concrete bounded handoff slice itself.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes whether that exact packet may be reused or which fields refresh.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_response_packet_carryforward
source_only_request_ladder.question: May that exact bounded response packet be reused unchanged, refreshed, or must it reopen in the successor release?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is whether an already-cut bounded response packet survives, refreshes, or reopens across the successor release.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The carryforward profile is the first sufficient owner for packet reuse posture across releases.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes which packet-local field families refresh inside a reusable packet.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_response_packet_delta
source_only_request_ladder.question: If a response packet is reused, what exact packet-local field families refresh?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the exact packet-local refresh delta for a reusable bounded response packet.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The delta ledger is the last notice-keyed packet owner before visible refresh wording begins.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes the visible successor-facing refresh sentence or family built on that delta.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_response_packet_refresh_notice
source_only_request_ladder.question: What exact visible reissue sentence may be surfaced for a reusable response packet?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the exact visible refresh sentence for a reusable bounded response packet.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The refresh notice is the first sufficient owner for what readers may visibly see when a packet is reissued.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes the canonical visible refresh family or the selection among such families.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_response_packet_refresh_notice_normal_form
source_only_request_ladder.question: Which canonical visible reissue wrapper family sits behind that emitted refresh sentence?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the canonical visible refresh wrapper family and slot structure.
source_only_request_ladder.why: Normal forms own the reusable visible reissue family rather than the emitted sentence instance.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes which visible refresh family was selected for this packet.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_response_packet_refresh_notice_selection
source_only_request_ladder.question: Which canonical visible refresh family was selected for the current reusable packet?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is which canonical visible refresh family was selected for the current reusable packet.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The selection ledger is the last visible-refresh owner before a successor-facing follow-up is fixed.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes a successor-facing follow-up choice or closure question about that visible sentence.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_response_packet_refresh_response_menu
source_only_request_ladder.question: After one concrete follow-up about the visible refresh sentence, which successor-facing owner is first sufficient?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the successor-facing follow-up owner choice after one concrete question about a visible refresh sentence.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The successor-facing response menu is the first sufficient owner once one visible-refresh follow-up class is fixed.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes the exact successor-facing packet cut or whether that branch is already closed.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_response_packet_refresh_response_packet

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_contract
source_only_request_ladder.question: What exact paper-level source-only promise does the public sentence make?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the exact paper-level source-only promise and its maintained packet/menu/validator cut.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The public request contract is the first sufficient owner for what the paper promised and which maintained cut stands behind that promise.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes omitted-support family naming, fulfillment/completion, or visible notice realization.

source_only_request_ladder.label: requestable_evidence_classes
source_only_request_ladder.question: Which omitted-support family names does that promise actually cover?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is naming or typing the omitted-support families behind the paper-level promise.
source_only_request_ladder.why: Evidence classes stabilize the support-family names without re-owning packet cuts or status compression.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes whether one such family has been fully supplied or how it is compressed publicly.

source_only_request_ladder.label: request_fulfillment_certificates
source_only_request_ladder.question: Has one promised omitted-support family actually been fully supplied?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is whether a promised omitted-support family has been fully satisfied.
source_only_request_ladder.why: Fulfillment certificates are the first sufficient owner for family-scoped completion rather than mere family naming.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes paper-level status compression or cross-release carryforward.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_status_envelope
source_only_request_ladder.question: What is the within-release paper-level public status of the overall source-only promise?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the within-release paper-level status token for the overall source-only promise.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The status envelope compresses fulfilled families to one paper-level public token without re-owning the certificates beneath it.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes successor carryforward or visible notice wording.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_carryforward_envelope
source_only_request_ladder.question: Does that paper-level source-only request status persist, advance, or reopen across the successor release?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is cross-release carryforward of the paper-level source-only request status token.
source_only_request_ladder.why: Carryforward is the first sufficient owner for successor persistence or reopening of the paper-level request promise.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes the exact outward-facing notice sentence or canonical family choice.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_notice
source_only_request_ladder.question: What exact outward-facing source-only notice sentence and pointer order were emitted?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the exact outward-facing source-only notice sentence and its reader-pointer order.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The notice is the first sufficient owner for what readers actually saw at paper level.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes the canonical notice family or slot structure behind that sentence.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_notice_normal_form
source_only_request_ladder.question: Which canonical notice family and slot structure sits behind that emitted source-only notice?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the canonical notice family and slot structure behind the emitted source-only notice.
source_only_request_ladder.why: Normal forms own the reusable notice family rather than the emitted sentence instance.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes which canonical family was selected for this release.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_notice_selection
source_only_request_ladder.question: Which canonical source-only notice family was actually selected for the current release?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is which canonical source-only notice family was actually selected for this release.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The selection ledger is the last paper-level source-only owner before one concrete follow-up class is fixed.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if one follow-up class is fixed and the question becomes the exact response-menu / request-class-owner / response-packet / packet-scope / packet-family-basis / packet-support-surface / packet-manifest-cut / packet-inventory-cut / packet-carryforward-profile / packet-delta-ledger chain.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_response_menu
source_only_request_ladder.question: Once one follow-up class is fixed, which maintained owner is the smallest sufficient handoff?

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_contract
source_only_request_ladder.question: What exact paper-level source-only promise does the public sentence make?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the exact paper-level source-only promise and its maintained packet/menu/validator cut.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The public request contract is the first sufficient owner for what the paper promised and which maintained cut stands behind that promise.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes omitted-support family naming, fulfillment/completion, or visible notice realization.

source_only_request_ladder.label: requestable_evidence_classes
source_only_request_ladder.question: Which omitted-support family names does that promise actually cover?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is naming or typing the omitted-support families behind the paper-level promise.
source_only_request_ladder.why: Evidence classes stabilize the support-family names without re-owning packet cuts or status compression.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes whether one such family has been fully supplied or how it is compressed publicly.

source_only_request_ladder.label: request_fulfillment_certificates
source_only_request_ladder.question: Has one promised omitted-support family actually been fully supplied?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is whether a promised omitted-support family has been fully satisfied.
source_only_request_ladder.why: Fulfillment certificates are the first sufficient owner for family-scoped completion rather than mere family naming.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes paper-level status compression or cross-release carryforward.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_status_envelope
source_only_request_ladder.question: What is the within-release paper-level public status of the overall source-only promise?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the within-release paper-level status token for the overall source-only promise.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The status envelope compresses fulfilled families to one paper-level public token without re-owning the certificates beneath it.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes successor carryforward or visible notice wording.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_carryforward_envelope
source_only_request_ladder.question: Does that paper-level source-only request status persist, advance, or reopen across the successor release?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is cross-release carryforward of the paper-level source-only request status token.
source_only_request_ladder.why: Carryforward is the first sufficient owner for successor persistence or reopening of the paper-level request promise.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes the exact outward-facing notice sentence or canonical family choice.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_notice
source_only_request_ladder.question: What exact outward-facing source-only notice sentence and pointer order were emitted?
source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the exact outward-facing source-only notice sentence and its reader-pointer order.
source_only_request_ladder.why: The notice is the first sufficient owner for what readers actually saw at paper level.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes the canonical notice family or slot structure behind that sentence.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_notice_normal_form

source_only_request_ladder.stop_when: The task is the canonical notice family and slot structure behind the emitted source-only notice.
source_only_request_ladder.why: Normal forms own the reusable notice family rather than the emitted sentence instance.
source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes which canonical family was selected for this release.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_notice_selection

source_only_request_ladder.widen_only_if: Widen only if one follow-up class is fixed and the question becomes the exact response-menu / request-class-owner / response-packet / packet-scope / packet-family-basis / packet-support-surface / packet-manifest-cut / packet-inventory-cut / packet-carryforward-profile / packet-delta-ledger chain.

source_only_request_ladder.label: public_request_response_packet_refresh_response_packet_closure

question_examples: Which theorem or lower bound justifies the fallback-vector claim?
generic_question_routes.why: Stop at the theorem root when no public claim, replay, or release-maintenance question is being asked.

question_examples: Where on the public receipt does the fallback contact-surface claim land?
generic_question_routes.why: The receipt anchor owns the released claim surface and should answer identification questions without widening into replay or review policy.

question_examples: What exact replay plan should be rerun to recompute the fallback vector?
generic_question_routes.why: Replay questions should stop at the replay anchor rather than drifting into successor wording or review packaging.

question_examples: If the contact surface drifts, what release-stage family must move and did the successor package close?
generic_question_routes.why: Release-evolution questions stop at the maintained release-stage owner before any downstream wrapper prose or review menu is consulted.

question_examples: What exact archive slice should travel when omitted support is requested about that shipped answer?
generic_question_routes.why: The disclosure packet is the first sufficient answer-side owner for the public-on-request archive cut before any wider review or source-only machinery is consulted.

question_examples: What is the smallest sufficient maintained handoff once a referee asks for more support after that archive cut?
generic_question_routes.why: Once the task widens past the paper-facing archive cut into follow-up packaging, the maintained review menu is the first sufficient owner.

question_examples: What source-only promise was made to readers, and what visible notice family was emitted?
generic_question_routes.why: These are adjacent source-only request owners, not extra spine segments; the routing rule is to stop at their first sufficient bucket rather than stretch the theorem-to-review bridge.

question_examples: After one follow-up-class choice, which bounded response packet travels and how may it be reused?
generic_question_routes.why: This is the first source-only bucket that owns concrete packet cuts and their reuse/delta rules.

question_examples: If that reused packet survives the successor cut, which visible refresh sentence/family may be surfaced?
generic_question_routes.why: Visible refresh wording belongs to its own owner bucket before any successor-facing follow-up choice is made.

question_examples: After one concrete follow-up about the refreshed visible sentence, which successor-facing packet closes the branch?
generic_question_routes.why: This final adjacent bucket owns the successor-facing follow-up choice, exact packet cut, and capstone closure verdict.
